title: Page groups
description: Groups of a multi-page layout's pages. The tab strip and page swipes show the pages of one group; a tab at the right end of the strip switches to the next group. A page that no group lists is shown in every group. Pages are named by their screen id in the layout. Without groups the strip shows every page.

keys.name: groups
keys.title: Groups
keys.description: One row per group. name: the label of its tab, a few letters. states: values of the state path that select it, comma-separated (sailing,motoring). pages: screen ids, comma-separated (course,wind,depth).

keys.name: auto
keys.title: Follow the boat's state
keys.description: Switch the group when the state path changes to a value a group lists. A group chosen by hand stays until the state selects another group. Off: groups change by hand only.

keys.name: path
keys.title: State path
keys.description: Signal K path whose value selects the group.

keys.name: hold_s
keys.title: Hold time
keys.description: How long a new state must stay before the group follows it, so a state that flickers does not flip the pages. The first state after a restart switches at once.
